title: SynopStationsFile
description: synop.<round>/<network>.stations.json, schema v2 (docs/synop.md section 5): one compact row per station. That network, issued and elements are the index's, the rows' count, width, order and byte spans, and each element's range are the readers' own checks.

issued.description: The round: a UTC minute that is a multiple of ten.

columns.description: The rows' columns by name: the seven below, the elements in their order, then offset and length. A reader finds a column by its name here; a round written before the field has the same layout and is read by position.

Timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC, to the second, with a Z suffix.

SynopStationRow.description: [id, lat, lon, elev, rank, name, obsTime, one current value per element, offset, length].
